turns.sql:
SELECT 
    e.*, 
    CASE 
        WHEN ROUND((julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE)) / 365.25) < 5 THEN 'entry-level'
        WHEN ROUND((julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE)) / 365.25) BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN 'professional'
        ELSE 'senior staff'
    END AS classification
FROM employees e
ORDER BY e.EMPLOYEE_ID;
